nodes.name: power_digital_3v3
nodes.description: TPS54331 buck regulator converts VIN_5V to the main digital rail VCC_3V3_DIGITAL for MCU and digital peripherals. EN defines regulator enable policy and should be configured for normal board startup from the 5V input. VSENSE is the output feedback sense node and must monitor the generated digital rail through the downstream feedback network. BOOT, SS, COMP, and PH require the standard switcher support network implemented later. This module is the only provider of the digital 3.3V rail and must keep its high-current switching return local before joining the common GND at the planned star-ground region.

nodes.name: power_analog_3v3
nodes.description: ME6211 LDO converts VIN_5V to the quieter analog/sensor rail VCC_3V3_ANALOG. CE defines regulator enable policy and should be configured so the analog rail is available during normal operation. NC remains unconnected. This module is the only provider of the analog 3.3V rail for sensors. The rail remains electrically separate from the digital 3.3V distribution, while its ground return still joins the common GND with star-ground routing intent rather than isolation.

nodes.name: CE

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F427 is the flight-controller processing core powered from the digital 3.3V rail. It is the bus master for one shared I2C link to the MPU-6050 and one shared SPI link to both BMP280 and W25Q128JV. It must expose distinct chip-select outputs for the barometer and Flash while sharing SPI_MOSI, SPI_MISO, and SPI_SCK. This module owns the digital control plane and should keep digital bus pull-up and default inactive chip-select policy consistent with attached peripherals. The MCU uses common GND and interfaces across the analog/digital partition only through defined signal nets and separate rail inputs to the peripherals.

nodes.name: imu
nodes.description: MPU-6050 IMU operates as an I2C sensor on the analog/sensor 3.3V rail and shares common GND. SCL and SDA connect to the MCU shared I2C bus. INT provides an interrupt/status output back to the MCU. CS must be configured for I2C operation rather than SPI. AD0 sets the I2C address selection and must be fixed to one logic state during implementation. AUX_DA and AUX_CL are auxiliary sensor-bus pins and are not used in this brief unless later expanded. CLKIN, FSYNC, REGOUT, CPOUT, and reserved pins require the vendor-recommended support treatment during detailed design. This module should be placed within the analog/sensor domain and returned to GND with low-noise routing intent.

nodes.name: CLKIN

nodes.name: AUX_DA

nodes.name: CPOUT

nodes.name: barometer
nodes.description: BMP280 barometric pressure sensor is planned in SPI mode on the shared MCU SPI bus and powered from the analog/sensor 3.3V rail. VDD and VDDIO should both be supplied from the analog rail unless later level-domain analysis requires otherwise. CSB is the dedicated chip-select input from the MCU. SDI, SDO, and SCK connect to the shared SPI bus. Because the brief explicitly requires shared SPI with separate chip-selects, this module must be configured for SPI operation rather than I2C. Both ground pins join common GND with quiet sensor return routing intent.

nodes.name: VDDIO
nodes.description: Interface supply 1.2-3.6V. Level for digital I/O.

nodes.name: CSB
nodes.description: SPI chip select (active low). Tie to VDDIO for I2C mode.

nodes.name: SDO
nodes.description: SPI data out. In I2C: address bit (GND=0x76, VDDIO=0x77).

nodes.name: blackbox_flash
nodes.description: W25Q128JV SPI NOR Flash provides black-box storage on the shared MCU SPI bus and is powered from the digital 3.3V rail. CS is a dedicated chip-select from the MCU, while DI, DO, and CLK connect to the shared SPI bus. WP and HOLD are additional control pins that must be driven or biased to their inactive state during detailed design so normal SPI memory access is not blocked; no separate controlling active device is provided in the brief. This module shares common GND and remains in the digital domain.

nodes.name: WP
nodes.description: Write Protect, active low (IO2 in Quad). Tie to VCC if unused.

nodes.name: HOLD
nodes.description: Hold/Reset, active low (IO3 in Quad). Tie to VCC if unused.
